title: Min Te Pao

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 746 / ASH
Date. 7/12/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

December 7th 1916.

Sir,
The following is a translation of an extract from the
Deutsche Zeitung fur China of December 6th 1916:-
" Beginning next month a new Chinese daily newspaper
will be issued which will be called the Min Te Pao 民德報
Preparations for the publication of the paper have already
been made by the Editorial Department in a building at
the Chang Su Ho's gardens (張蘇河). The Printing machines
are expected to arrive shortly."

General Yang will visit the Szecheun Guild at 10 a.m.
today and will offer sacrifice before the coffin containing
the remains of the late General Tsai Oo on behalf of
President Li Yuen Hung.
The masters and employees of the bean curd shops
in Shanghai met in a teashop at 185 Canton Road at 3 p.m.
6th inst and later had dinner together in a restaurant
on Canton Road. They discussed ways and means to raise
funds to build a Guild. Although it was previously reported
that the employees intended to demand a higher wage,
this subject was not mentioned.
Zung Tsung Hyui 淞宗惠 who arrived here recently
from Canton has retained Dr. Kreig as his medical adviser.
Another performance was given in the Kiukiang Road
theatre last night in aid of the destitute rebels. The
house was again full.

Your Obedient Servant,
WBnewplck
Detective Sub Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Enters on M.S. Dec 7.
page_data.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记处
编号 746 / ASH
日期：1916年12月7日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1916年12月7日。

先生：
以下系1916年12月6日《德文新报》（Deutsche Zeitung fur China）摘录之译文：——
“自下月起，将发行一份新的中文日报，名为《民德报》。编辑部已在张苏河花园的一处建筑内为该报的出版做好了准备工作。印刷机预计不久后运抵。”

杨将军将于今日上午10时访问四川会馆，并代表黎元洪总统向已故蔡锷将军的灵柩致祭。
上海各豆腐店的店主与雇员于本月6日下午3时在广东路185号的一家茶馆集会，随后在广东路的一家餐馆共进晚餐。他们讨论了筹集资金以建立会馆的方法与途径。尽管此前有报道称雇员意图要求增加工资，但此次会议并未提及此议题。
近期从广州抵达此地的淞宗惠（音译）已聘请克里格医生（Dr. Kreig）担任其医疗顾问。
昨晚在九江路剧院再次举行了一场演出，以援助贫困的反叛者。剧场再次座无虚席。

您顺从的仆人，
WBnewplck
侦探副督察

警察总监

录入于工部局档案，12月7日。
